leader.name: Uta (ST11-001)
leader.text: [DON!! x1] [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] Reveal 1 card from the top of your deck and add up to 1 "FILM" type card to your hand. Then, place the rest at the bottom of your deck.

cards.name: Bartolomeo
cards.text: [End of Your Turn] You may rest this Character: Set up to 1 of your "FILM" type Characters other than [Bartolomeo] as active.

cards.name: Fleeting Lullaby
cards.text:
[Main] If your Leader is [Uta], up to 2 of your opponent's rested Characters with a cost of 4 or less will not become active in your opponent's next Refresh Phase.

[Trigger] Activate this card's [Main] effect.

cards.name: Where the Wind Blows
cards.text:
[Main] If your Leader is [Uta], set all of your "FILM" type Characters as active at the end of this turn.

[Trigger] Set all of your "FILM" type Characters as active.

cards.name: The World's Continuation
cards.text: [Counter] If your Leader is [Uta], you may return any number of Characters on your field to the owner's hand. Up to 1 of your Leader or Character cards gains +2000 power during this battle for every returned Character.

cards.name: Tot Musica
cards.text: [Main] You may rest 1 of your [Uta] cards: Rest up to 2 of your opponent's DON!! cards.

cards.name: Backlight
cards.text:
[Main] If your Leader is [Uta], choose one:

• Rest up to 1 of your opponent's Characters with a cost of 5 or less.

• K.O. up to 1 of your opponent's rested Characters with a cost of 5 or less.

cards.name: New Genesis
cards.text: [Main] If your Leader is [Uta], look at 3 cards from the top of your deck; reveal up to 1 "FILM" type card other than [New Genesis] and add it to your hand. Then, place the rest at the bottom of your deck in any order and set up to 1 of your DON!! cards as active.

cards.name: I'm invincible
cards.text:
[Main] Set up to 1 of your [Uta] Leader as active.

[Trigger] Up to 1 of your Leader or Character cards gains +1000 power during this turn.

cards.text:
